record.question: The power to increase the number of judges in the Supreme Court of India is vested in:
record.explanation: Answer B: The Parliament. Parliament may by law increase the number of Supreme Court judges under Article 124(1). Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
